correctness.rationale: The graph is the Cayley graph on F_2^4 with difference generators 1,2,4,8,15; closed radius-one balls give the 16 maximal 6-vertex facets by Adams–Shukla–Singh Lemma 2.2. Fresh independent finite enumeration verified 808 nonempty faces with f=(16,120,320,240,96,16), all 120 pairs of distinct facet intersections have size two, and the sequential matching has 376 augmented pairs, including (empty,{0}), hence 375 ordinary pairs and exactly one critical 0-cell, one 1-cell, and 56 2-cells. All 2752 augmented cover incidences form an acyclic reversed-Hasse orientation (full topological sort). Independent signed integral boundary projection on the original incidence relation gives 44 coefficients 0, six +2, six -2 against the single critical edge; mod-2 ranks [15,104,160,80,16] and mod-3 ranks [15,105,160,80,16] independently corroborate torsion. Forman discrete Morse gives a CW model with one 0-, one 1- and 56 2-cells. A degree-two attaching map makes RP2; all other loops have degree divisible by 2 and are null in pi1(RP2), yielding RP2 wedge 55 S2, not merely matching homology. This is an exact finite-object proof, not a numerical extrapolation. Torsion in H1 excludes pure shellability. Boundaries: only the 5-regular Clebsch graph and scale 2; no uniform statement for other dimensions or scales.
risks: The combinatorial Morse calculation is finite and exact but is not formal verification in Lean; source and independent program share the same deterministic matching convention.
The theorem concerns no other folded cube dimensions/scales; field ranks alone would not establish the integral attaching-degree homotopy decomposition.

originality.rationale: Definitive statement-level coverage by an earlier separately published Kummer biplane block-complex theorem. The original candidate sixteen facets translate the binary set {0,1,2,4,8,15}, exactly the classical Kummer B(6,1) difference-set biplane in White §3.1. An independently found and completely checked permutation of the sixteen vertices identifies its complete facet family with the sixteen rook-graph open-neighborhood blocks in the earlier Kummer theorem. The prior theorem proves exactly RP2 vee 55 S2 and the same derived homology/fundamental group. Merely relabeling one model and computing a different Morse matching is not new mathematical coverage. The earlier source Git import predates this candidate by 85 seconds, but no claim of independent discovery priority is necessary.

However, this submitted final claim is exactly an already established Kummer biplane block-complex homotopy calculation, with no distinct invariant, classification, sharp boundary or non-implied conclusion. Its alternative Cayley labelling and matching implementation improve exposition/reproducibility but do not create a new mathematical fact. No standalone new biplane-isomorphism theorem appears in the assessed RESULT and one should not silently count an audit-discovered permutation as part of the submitted claim.
